description: Change a webhook endpoint: URL, events, or turn it off (active: false).

active.description: false pauses delivery; pending retries for a paused endpoint are dropped.

description.description: A note on what the endpoint is for

events.description: Event types to send, or * for all

numbers.description: Replace the number filter; [] or null clears it.

url.description: The https URL that receives the events

title: Update webhook
